g.text: Risk interaction lower bound: must be positive
Four links required for a full masking claim
Bars show unadjusted 95% t intervals. The planned joint decision uses directional tests and Holm adjustment.
Risk lower bounds include every planned seed and every unknown risky outcome. They are not risk point estimates.
